Compose a resignation letter as if you be Zuckerberg.

Dear Board of Directors,

I am writing to formally tender my resignation from my role as Chief Executive Officer, effective two weeks from today. This decision has not been made lightly; it follows careful reflection on my personal priorities and the company’s next chapter.

Over the past years, we have built products that connect people at an unprecedented scale. I remain proud of the teams who have driven innovation, navigated intense scrutiny, and continued to push forward through rapid changes in technology and culture.

In the coming days, I will work closely with the leadership team and the board to ensure a smooth transition. I am committed to helping identify and support the next CEO, and to transferring context on our long-term strategy, key initiatives, and relationships with partners and regulators.

Thank you for the trust and the opportunity to serve. I will continue to support the company’s mission in whatever capacity is most helpful after my departure.

Sincerely,  
Mark Zuckerberg
